mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/scripts && cat > /root/autodl-tmp/scripts/eval_lr5e6_rp_ckpt20_cuda3.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# rp_r2 (P0+P1) checkpoint-20 eval on cuda:3
source /etc/network_turbo
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/autodl-tmp

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python -m freige.eval.batch_eval \
  --exp_dir /root/autodl-tmp/grpo_ced_lr5e6_rp \
  --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output \
  --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/grpo_ced_lr5e6_rp \
  --checkpoints 20 \
  --quantize
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/scripts/eval_lr5e6_rp_ckpt20_cuda3.sh
echo "SCRIPT_CREATED"
